title: Find Peak Element
summary: Identify an element in the array that is strictly greater than its adjacent elements.
statement: Identify an element in the array that is strictly greater than its adjacent elements. Given an array nums, locate and return the index of any peak element. Assume the array extends infinitely in both directions with negative infinity. Develop an algorithm with a time complexity of O(log n).
constraints: nums is nonempty and adjacent values differ.
Return any index strictly greater than both existing neighbors; outside values are negative infinity.
reference_solution:
def find_peak_index(nums):
    left,right=0,len(nums)-1
    while left<right:
        middle=(left+right)//2
        if nums[middle]>nums[middle+1]:right=middle
        else:left=middle+1
    return left

    left,right=0,len(nums)-1

hints: A rising slope guarantees some peak to its right; a falling slope guarantees one at or left of the midpoint.
Keep mid on a falling slope and mid+1 on a rising slope.
The retained interval always contains a peak and shrinks to one valid index.
